0022600175.text: The Bucks (1-5) enter this eighth game of their season 14th in the East and fifth in the Central, four games back, after losing their last two on the road. The Celtics (5-1) are riding a five-game winning streak, are 4-0 at home, and sit second in the Atlantic, half a game back, while Devin Carter (illness) and Paul George (rest) are out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Boston won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 133-101 win over Milwaukee on April 3, 2026.
